description: Mechanical engineering student, want to create a simple app that will help explorers navigate through mars as easily as earth.
summary:
Mars Street View: A solution for the Interplanetary Survival Guide challenge.
I've created an interactive map of the Jezero Crater, an ancient lakebed that is currently being explored by the perseverance rover. The map contains a lot of information gathered from NASA's public data bases that is useful for future explorers of the area. Other than the regular top down view with information layers, the map features a 3d point of view, using panoramic photos taken by the rover and 3d models made to simulate the places the rover cant reach all together give the explorer a hub with all the information he needs to get ready for the expedition.
details: The project is supposed to help future astronauts, and any one interested in exploring mars, specifically the significant jezero crater. It provides a 2d view filled with information the explorer might find important, for example weather conditions, ground stability and elevation. In addition you can get on the ground and view the area with panoramic views either by photos taken by perseverance, or 3d models created to simulate the terrain and weather conditions. The purpose of the project is to simplify planning and exploration of Mars and make it a similar experience like on Earth. I gathered data about chemical structures of the ground, mapping, weather readings, sun angles all from NASA's data bases for the rover. using claude, a CAD software and all the data gathered to create this App. I think that creating a simple platform with familiar features helps not only astronauts in preparing more easily, but for anyone interested to be able to explore by themselves.
